title.narrative: EU support to integrated border management and fight to transnational crime in Jordan.

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to contribute to the development of the long-term capability of Jordan to control and manage its borders and to ensure greater security for citizens and visitors, while guaranteeing the respect for the rule of law and human rights standards. the focus of the specific contract will be on providing capacity building on fighting transnational crime.
